header.superHtml:
As your little bundle of joy grows, our Super Squad helps them safely grow super mouths straight from the get-go. Tooth Keri has sent her castle and best buddy, baby Bristles, to help babies build strong jaws and mouths and ease teething pains. One of Tooth Keri’s superpowers is removing pain, after all! Sugar-loving Cavitar also makes an appearance with his peek-a-boo, double-scoop ice cream teething ring, which can be stored in the refrigerator (not the freezer) to ease sore gums with refreshing coolness. Teething rings are:

  • made with soft, flexible silicone to ease teething pains
  • safe, easy to hold, gum, and chew
  • made without BPA/BPS/BPF, PVC, or phthalates

left.text: We are so confident you'll love our customized oral care solutions, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. Experience the best in oral health—risk-free.
